cd /office; python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv,json
# 9日：容量（调拨后）、锁定、实占、版本
cap={'东港':7,'西湾':8,'南站':9,'北仓':6}
info={ # 案号:(站,实占,锁定,额度,优先号,批文)
'J01':('东港',2,0,4,2,'7002'),'J02':('东港',4,0,6,1,'章程'),'J03':('东港',1,1,7,1,'2020'),
'J04':('西湾',2,0,8,2,'7032'),'J05':('西湾',3,3,7,1,'2040'),'J06':('西湾',1,1,5,1,'7052'),
'J07':('南站',4,2,8,1,'2060'),'J08':('南站',3,0,8,0,'7072'),'J09':('南站',0,0,10,0,'2080'),
'J10':('北仓',2,1,7,2,'7092'),'J11':('北仓',3,2,5,3,'2100'),'J12':('北仓',1,0,6,1,'7112')}
ver={'J01':4,'J02':3,'J03':2,'J04':4,'J05':2,'J06':2,'J07':4,'J08':4,'J09':2,'J10':4,'J11':2,'J12':2}
target={}
for st,c in cap.items():
    cs=sorted([k for k in info if info[k][0]==st],key=lambda k:(info[k][4],k))
    avail=c-sum(info[k][2] for k in cs)
    print(st,'容量',c,'锁定',sum(info[k][2] for k in cs),'可用',avail,'顺序',cs)
    for k in cs:
        _,occ,lock,quota,pri,_=info[k]
        net=max(0,quota-lock); add=min(net,avail); avail-=add
        target[k]=lock+add
        print('   ',k,'实占',occ,'锁定',lock,'额度',quota,'净需求',net,'→目标',target[k])
print('目标',target,{st:sum(target[k] for k in target if info[k][0]==st) for st in cap})
dec=sorted([k for k in target if target[k]<info[k][1]])
inc=sorted([k for k in target if target[k]>info[k][1]])
same=sorted([k for k in target if target[k]==info[k][1]])
print('减',[(k,info[k][1],target[k]) for k in dec])
print('增',[(k,info[k][1],target[k]) for k in inc])
print('不动',same)
json.dump({'target':target,'ver':ver,'info':{k:list(v) for k,v in info.items()},'cap':cap},open('scratch/day9.json','w'))
with open('scratch/09-申请/申请-09-1.csv','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    pass
EOF
mkdir -p scratch/09-申请; python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv,json
d=json.load(open('/office/scratch/day9.json'))
T=d['target']; V=d['ver']; I=d['info']
dec=[k for k in sorted(T) if T[k]<I[k][1]]
with open('/office/scratch/09-申请/申请-09-1.csv','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\r\n'); w.writerow(['案号','请求号','预期版本','目标席'])
    for k in dec: w.writerow([k,f'E9A-{k}-1',V[k],T[k]])
print(open('/office/scratch/09-申请/申请-09-1.csv').read())
EOF
